title: Test launcher has no supported stop for a detached run, so a gate whose input is already known bad holds the shared gate slot to its END
outcome: Test launcher has no supported stop for a detached run, so a gate whose input is already known bad holds the shared gate slot to its END
acceptance: scripts/test-launcher.mjs offers a supported stop for a detached run by its run directory or id, which terminates the run's whole process tree, records a typed terminal result (stopped, never passed) with the reason and the stopping caller, and notifies the run's notify target.
A stopped run frees its execution lock and leaves no orphaned cargo, rustc, test-binary or vitest process; tests cover stop during each stage and a stop racing a natural END.
docs/test.md documents when to stop (for example, the gated input already has an in-scope Medium) and that a stopped run is never landing evidence.
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
